name: rolling-hash pattern match
mechanism: hash every window of the text with a hash that updates in constant time as the window slides, compare hashes to the pattern hashes, and verify only on hash equality

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Rabin–Karp string search algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Substrings: searches multiple patterns efficiently

fails_when: hash collisions force verification; adversarial inputs collide
